name: Warrior
description: For those who want to play as someone sturdy, wearing heavy armor and fighting with weapons like swords, spears, and halberds.

name: Renegade
description: For those focused on stealth, sneak attacks, and subterfuge—or assassination and seduction!

name: Mage
description: For those who wish to wield mystical powers, casting arcane spells and unleashing the elements of frost, fire, and lightning.

name: Naturalist
description: For those who want to work closely with nature and animals, living in harmony with the natural world.

name: Zealot
description: For those who wish to combine magical and martial prowess in devotion to a higher principle or power.
